authenticity_review: Despite strong perceptual quality (no noise/blur per auditor), structural integrity is compromised. The animal_pose_auditor reported MEDIUM artifact risk (31% low-confidence keypoints), concentrated in hind limbs and faces. Visually verified: paws lack toe definition and merge into grass (melting), chest fur shows symmetrical texture mirroring, and shoulder boundaries between adjacent dogs are fused. These are not minor texture issues but fundamental anatomical failures that contradict biological reality. The breed mismatch (Retrievers vs German Shepherds) further indicates semantic drift rather than intentional variation.
key_defects: Count error: 6 dogs generated instead of 7
Breed misalignment: Flat-Coated Retrievers produced despite German Shepherd taxonomy (floppy ears, blocky skulls, level toplines)
Structural melting: Paws/lower legs lack anatomical definition and fuse with ground plane
Texture hallucination: Symmetrical patterned distortion in front dog's chest fur
Spatial fusion: Indistinct boundaries between shoulders of adjacent back-row dogs
